FICTIONAL TEST REPORT
RADIOGRAPH RIGHT KNEE, WEIGHT BEARING AP AND LATERAL
Date of examination: 26/03/2025
Clinical details: Chronic medial knee pain, 67 year old.
FINDINGS:
There is marked narrowing of the medial tibiofemoral joint space to 2 mm, with subchondral sclerosis and marginal osteophytes on the medial femoral condyle and tibial plateau. The lateral compartment is relatively preserved, with a joint space of 6 mm. Osteophytes are present at the superior and inferior poles of the patella, and the patellofemoral joint space is mildly reduced. There is a small joint effusion. No fracture or focal bone lesion is seen. Mild varus alignment is noted. Vascular calcification is present in the popliteal region.
IMPRESSION:
1. Severe medial compartment osteoarthritis of the right knee.
2. Mild patellofemoral degenerative change.
